name: @zavx0z/storybook
label: Storybook
description: Единый внешний сервер Storybook: навигация по структуре пакетов, документация и выполнение сценариев.

scripts.typecheck: bun install --cwd container/spec/fixture --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun install --cwd cluster/spec/fixture --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && tsc --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.test: bun test --no-orphans --isolate --preload @immersive/headless/preload ./app ./tech ./chat ./project ./repo ./package ./specs ./domain ./cluster ./component ./container ./contracts ./typedoc ./tests --max-concurrency=1 --path-ignore-patterns '{**/fixture/**,**/fixtures/**,**/isolation.integration.test.ts,**/mcp-lazy-startup.test.ts}' && bun test --no-orphans --isolate ./tests/isolation.integration.test.ts --max-concurrency=1 && bun test --isolate ./app/test/mcp-lazy-startup.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
